title: IonQ Announces Pricing of $2.0 Billion Equity Offering Purchased by Heights Capital Management - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Quantum computing platform and foundry operator IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) has announced the pricing of a $2.0 billion equity offering. The transaction is being purchased directly from the underwriter by an investment entity managed by Heights Capital Management, Inc.

The equity offering consists of 20.5 million shares of common stock and 29.5 million pre-funded warrants, each priced at $40.00 per unit. The $40.00 purchase price represents a 15% premium over IonQ’s closing stock price of $34.78 on October 13, 2026. In addition, the agreement includes seven-year warrants to purchase up to 100 million additional shares of common stock at an exercise price of $69.46 per share, representing a 100% premium to the October 13 closing price.

IonQ plans to use the gross proceeds to accelerate the commercialization, manufacturing, and deployment of its full-stack quantum platform across computing, networking, sensing, and cybersecurity. The capital raise builds upon recent milestones cited by CEO Niccolo de Masi, including IonQ’s advancement to Stage C of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, its strategic partnership with NVIDIA, and its previous acquisitions of semiconductor foundry SkyWater Technology and Zero Trust security provider Elisity.
